content.text: 全新 Zalith-Launcher 移植内核（包名 com.kcl.pcl）：保留陶瓦联机并新增 KCL 社区联机大厅；修复低内存真机联机闪退；作者龙腾OS（ETC Team），赞助 https://b23.tv/o42pOXH。更新源已切换至本仓库，可直接检查更新。

New Zalith-Launcher based KCL Mobile (package com.kcl.pcl): Terracotta online + new KCL community lobby; fixed crash on low-memory devices; author LongTengOS (ETC Team). Update source switched to this repo.
